content.text:
Are you looking for **Volume V** of *The Book of the Thousand Nights and One Night / A Night*?

There are two similarly titled versions:

1. **Richard F. Burton’s translation**: *The Book of the Thousand Nights and a Night, Volume 5* — available free on Project Gutenberg. It begins with **“The Ebony Horse”** and includes tales such as **“Uns al-Wujud and the Wazir’s Daughter Rose-in-Hood”** and **“The Queen of Serpents.”** ([gutenberg.org](https://www.gutenberg.org/files/54257/54257-h/54257-h.htm?utm_source=openai))

2. **J. C. Mardrus / E. Powys Mathers version**: *The Book of the Thousand Nights and One Night, Volume V* — an English rendering by **E. Powys Mathers** from Dr. J. C. Mardrus’s French version, published in editions such as the 1923 Casanova Society edition. ([biblio.com](https://www.biblio.com/book/book-thousand-nights-one-night-volume/d/1429178850?utm_source=openai))

If you want to **read it online**, the Burton Volume 5 is the easiest public-domain version to access via Project Gutenberg. If you want, I can also provide a **summary**, **table of contents**, or help identify a **specific edition**.
